name: Amanda Staehely
occupation: Nursery owner (per Capital Chronicle voter guide)

bio.statement: The Oregon Association of Nurseries news site says Staehely spent most of her life pursuing a ballet career before moving to Pilates and the family nursery business.
bio.excerpt: spent most of her life pursuing a ballet career

bio.statement: The same article says she advocated for the nursery industry before the Oregon Legislature, Congress and federal agencies as an association leader.
bio.excerpt: advocated for the industry in the halls of the Oregon Legislature, U.S. Congress

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Staehely lists her occupation as farmer and nursery owner of Columbia Nursery, and past president of the Oregon Association of Nurseries.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Farmer/Nursery Owner, Columbia Nursery Occupational Background: Small Business Owner, Nursery Owner, Past President of Oregon Association of Nurseries

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45

bio.statement: Staehely lists Canby High School as her educational background.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45

bio.statement: Staehely lists no prior governmental experience.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45

positions.statement: Staehely says Salem has developed a habit of solving problems with taxes and that government should prioritize core functions by reducing non-essential spending.
positions.excerpt: GOOD GOVERNANCE Salem has developed a nasty habit of solving problems with taxes.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45

positions.statement: Staehely says that when businesses thrive, families and communities do too.
positions.excerpt: When businesses thrive, families and communities do too.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45

positions.statement: Staehely says one-size-fits-all policies inhibit learning.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45

positions.statement: Staehely says Salem makes farming too expensive and challenging to navigate for family farms.
positions.excerpt: Salem ties the hands of family farms; farming has gotten too expensive and challenging to navigate.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 45
